references.text: Mockery and blows against a righteous person, which is a foreshadowing of Christ's sufferings
King David was mocked and beaten, which predicts the treatment Jesus received
Paul describes how evil people will persecute the righteous, which is reflected in the treatment Jesus received
The prophecy about the Messiah offering his back to those who strike him, and his cheeks to those who pull out his beard
Jeremiah was beaten and put in stocks, which predicts Jesus' sufferings
